ui.log.food_harvested: Harvest to the pantry: {kcal} kcal raw.
ui.log.food_spoiled.unharvested: Harvest lost: it was not picked in time.

comms.daily.d1: Good morning, Ares Uno. 7-day shift started.
comms.daily.d2: Day 2. The crop is ready today: harvest within 12 h.

dev.help:
Ares Uno — Browser and WebXR controls
• Keyboard: W/A/S/D or arrows (move) · Q/E (turn).
• Mouse: drag to look · click to press buttons or teleport.
• Tools: G (grab/drop) · F (hold to use the tool or the hose) · R (rotate the held item) · H (belt).
• VR headset: start menu → «Virtual reality».
ui.log.link_lost.signal: Link with Earth lost: signal below {min} %. Messages are queued.
ui.log.link_lost.conjunction: Solar conjunction: the Sun hides the Earth. No link until it passes.
ui.log.solar_cleaned.shield: Panels cleaned with the electrodynamic shield: +{pct} % output.
ui.log.solar_cleaned.devil: A dust devil swept the panels: +{pct} % output.
ui.log.solar_rejected.storm: No point cleaning now: the storm keeps dropping dust.
ui.log.solar_rejected.relay: No power for the shield: reset the relay.
ui.log.solar_rejected.battery: Not enough battery to clean the panels.
summary.cause.radiation: Cause: radiation from a solar storm, outside the shelter.
comms.sep.forecast: Alert! Huge solar flare. The particles will reach Mars in about {minutes} min. Go to the shelter in the crew quarters.
hint.sep.impact: Solar particle storm in progress. Get into the water shelter in the crew quarters (the bunk alcove) until it drops.
hint.dust.devil: A dust devil passes by the solar field.
ui.log.solar_tracker.auto: Sun tracker on AUTO: the panels follow the Sun.
ui.log.solar_tracker.stow: Panels stowed edge-on: less dust, but no power.
ui.log.solar_rejected.tracker: The sun tracker has no power: reset the relay.
hint.solar.manual: Turn the panels with «◀ Left» and «Right ▶», under the window, or press «Auto» so they follow the Sun (its motor uses a little power). «Stow» turns them edge-on during a storm.
ui.log.kitchen_spoiled: {name} went bad in the pantry (−{kcal} kcal).
ui.log.hydro_nutrients_low: Hydroponics: low on nutrients, the plants grow slowly.
ui.log.hydro_rejected.full: The nutrient tank is already full.
ui.log.relay_no_spare: No spare parts left to replace the burned relay.
ui.log.relay_replaced: Burned relay replaced: 1 spare part used.
ui.log.relay_no_tool: You need the screwdriver to replace the burned relay: take it from the tool wall in the central hall.
comms.science.cores: Earth: report on {cores} rock core(s) received ({total} in total). Science to understand Mars' past!
